## Roles

| Role | Data scope | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Platform Admin | all reports | Runs the portal. Full visibility, assigns owners, tunes alert rules, reads the audit log. |
| FinOps Analyst | all reports | Owns the cloud bill. Reads every cost, chargeback and data-quality view; changes nothing. |
| Report Owner | own reports only | Accountable for specific reports. Sees and acknowledges alerts and cost for those reports only. |
| Viewer | all reports | Read-only health view. No cost figures; owner email addresses are masked. |

## Real-time events (server to client)

Envelope: `{ "v": 1, "id": <integer>, "type": "<event type>", "ts": "<ISO-8601>", "data": { ... } }`

| Event `type` | Topic | When it is sent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection.ready` | — | First message on every connection. States who the server thinks you are and how many missed events follow. |
| `alert.fired` | `alerts` | A report crossed an alert rule and no alert was open for that rule and report. Sent once per incident, not once per breaching observation. |
| `alert.updated` | `alerts` | Another breaching observation was folded in (`occurrence`), severity moved, or a person acknowledged or snoozed it. |
| `alert.resolved` | `alerts` | The condition stayed healthy for the rule's `resolveAfter` consecutive observations. |
| `telemetry.observed` | `telemetry` | Raw feed for live tickers. High volume; clients must opt in to the `telemetry` topic. |
| `report.owner_changed` | `reports` | Clients should refetch report lists and the orphan queue. |
| `system.notice` | `system` | For example: the telemetry simulator was paused or an alert rule was changed. |
| `replay.gap` | — | The client asked to resume from an event id that has left the buffer. It must refetch state over REST; live events continue from here. |
| `subscribed` | — | Reply to `subscribe` / `unsubscribe` with the resulting topic set. |
| `pong` | — | Reply to a client `ping`. Echoes the client timestamp so the client can measure round-trip time. |
| `error` | — | A client message was malformed or not allowed. The connection stays open unless the code is `unauthorized`. |

## Client messages (WebSocket only)

| Message `type` | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `ping` | Send at least every `heartbeatIntervalMs`. The server closes connections that stay silent for twice that. |
| `subscribe` | Adds topics to the connection. Row-level security still applies to everything delivered. |
| `unsubscribe` | Stops delivery for the given topics. |

## WebSocket close codes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 4401 | Missing, expired or already-used ticket |
| 4408 | No heartbeat received |
| 4429 | Client is not reading fast enough |
| 1001 | Server is shutting down |

## Alert rules (defaults)

| Rule | In brief | Fires when | Severity | Resolves after |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `latency` | yes | load time > 15 s | warning > 15 s, high > 30 s, critical > 45 s | 2 healthy observations |
| `refresh_failure` | yes | refresh is FAILED or TIMED_OUT | high; critical from 3 consecutive failures | 1 healthy observation |
| `refresh_unknown` | no | refresh is UNKNOWN | info | 1 healthy observation |
| `invalid_telemetry` | no | credits < 0 | warning | 1 healthy observation |
